panels.title: Missing data
panels.sql: WITH sources AS (SELECT 'builder_blog' AS step, 'Articles' AS label, 1 AS position, false AS opt_in UNION ALL SELECT 'ga4', 'Pageviews', 2, false UNION ALL SELECT 'daily_dev', 'daily.dev visits', 3, false UNION ALL SELECT 'search_console', 'Search clicks and impressions', 4, false UNION ALL SELECT 'search_console_queries', 'Search queries', 5, false UNION ALL SELECT 'signups', 'Builder signups', 6, false UNION ALL SELECT 'agent_native_signups', 'Agent-Native signups', 7, false UNION ALL SELECT 'youtube', 'YouTube views', 8, true UNION ALL SELECT 'x', 'X posts', 9, true), latest AS (SELECT step, status, started_at FROM (SELECT step, status, started_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY step ORDER BY started_at DESC) AS rn FROM analytics_content_collection_runs WHERE started_at >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ranked WHERE rn = 1), runs AS (SELECT COALESCE(sources.step, latest.step) AS step, COALESCE(sources.label, latest.step) AS label, COALESCE(sources.position, 10) AS position, latest.status, latest.started_at FROM sources FULL JOIN latest ON latest.step = sources.step WHERE NOT (COALESCE(sources.opt_in, false) AND latest.status IS NULL)) SELECT severity, message FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN status IN ('failed', 'cost_limited') THEN 'critical' WHEN status IS NULL OR status = 'not_configured' THEN 'warning' ELSE 'info' END AS severity, '**' || label || CASE WHEN status IS NULL THEN ' haven''t been collected in the last 30 days' WHEN status = 'failed' THEN ' failed' WHEN status = 'cost_limited' THEN ' stopped at the cost cap' WHEN status = 'not_configured' THEN ' aren''t connected yet' WHEN status = 'running' THEN ' are collecting now' ELSE ' ' || status END || '**' || CASE WHEN status = 'not_configured' AND step IN ('search_console', 'search_console_queries') THEN ': waiting for Search Console access.' WHEN status = 'not_configured' AND step IN ('ga4', 'daily_dev') THEN ': waiting for a GA4 property.' WHEN status = 'not_configured' AND step = 'youtube' THEN ': waiting for channels and a YouTube Data API key.' WHEN status = 'not_configured' AND step = 'x' THEN ': waiting for accounts and an X API Bearer token.' WHEN status IS NULL OR status IN ('not_configured', 'running') THEN '.' ELSE ' on the ' || to_char(substr(started_at, 1, 10)::date, 'Mon FMDD') || ' run.' END AS message, position FROM runs WHERE COALESCE(status, '') <> 'succeeded' UNION ALL SELECT 'info', 'Nothing is missing: every source collected on its last run.', 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE COALESCE(status, '') <> 'succeeded') ) notices ORDER BY position

panels.title: Builder signups per day
panels.sql: WITH RECURSIVE dates AS (SELECT CASE '{{timeRange}}' WHEN '7d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 7 WHEN '28d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 28 WHEN '90d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 90 WHEN 'custom' THEN NULLIF('{{timeRangeStart}}', '')::date ELSE (SELECT MIN(metric_date)::date FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'signups_first_touch') END AS day UNION ALL SELECT day + 1 FROM dates WHERE day < CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - 1, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END), totals AS (SELECT s.metric_date AS date, SUM(s.value) AS signups FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' AND (s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY s.metric_date) SELECT to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, totals.signups FROM dates LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.date = to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE dates.day <= CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - 1, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END ORDER BY dates.day

config.description: Builder.io accounts, each credited to the blog article that was the person's first visit, on the day of that visit, even when they signed up days later.

panels.title: Agent-Native signups per day
panels.sql: WITH RECURSIVE dates AS (SELECT CASE '{{timeRange}}' WHEN '7d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 7 WHEN '28d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 28 WHEN '90d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 90 WHEN 'custom' THEN NULLIF('{{timeRangeStart}}', '')::date ELSE (SELECT MIN(metric_date)::date FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'agent_native_signups') END AS day UNION ALL SELECT day + 1 FROM dates WHERE day < CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - 1, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END), totals AS (SELECT s.metric_date AS date, SUM(s.value) AS signups FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric = 'agent_native_signups' AND (s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY s.metric_date) SELECT to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, totals.signups FROM dates LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.date = to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE dates.day <= CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - 1, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END ORDER BY dates.day

config.description: Agent-Native app signups whose link from an article was tagged with that article (`utm_content`), on the day of the signup. Untagged links aren't counted.

panels.title: Pageviews and search clicks per day
panels.sql: WITH RECURSIVE dates AS (SELECT CASE '{{timeRange}}' WHEN '7d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 7 WHEN '28d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 28 WHEN '90d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 90 WHEN 'custom' THEN NULLIF('{{timeRangeStart}}', '')::date ELSE (SELECT MIN(metric_date)::date FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots WHERE metric IN ('ga4_pageviews', 'search_console_clicks')) END AS day UNION ALL SELECT day + 1 FROM dates WHERE day < CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - 1, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END), totals AS (SELECT s.metric_date AS date, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'ga4_pageviews') AS pageviews, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'search_console_clicks') AS search_clicks FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric IN ('ga4_pageviews', 'search_console_clicks') AND (s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY s.metric_date) SELECT to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, totals.pageviews, totals.search_clicks FROM dates LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.date = to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE dates.day <= CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - 1, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END ORDER BY dates.day

config.description: Search clicks can be higher than pageviews: GA4 misses visitors who block analytics or decline cookies, and Search Console counts every click from Google. Since collection began reaches back as far as either goes; Search Console's history goes back up to 16 months.

panels.title: Builder signups by author
panels.sql: WITH per_article AS (SELECT i.id, i.title, i.url AS href, COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author, i.published_at, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch') AS signups, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'agent_native_signups') AS agent_native_signups FROM analytics_content_items i LEFT JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND (s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, i.author, i.published_at) SELECT author, SUM(signups) AS signups FROM per_article GROUP BY author HAVING SUM(signups) > 0 ORDER BY signups DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Articles
panels.sql: WITH per_article AS (SELECT i.id, i.title, i.url AS href, COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author, i.published_at, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch') AS signups, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'agent_native_signups') AS agent_native_signups, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'ga4_pageviews') AS pageviews, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'daily_dev_sessions') AS daily_dev_visits, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'search_console_clicks') AS clicks, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'search_console_impressions') AS impressions, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'search_console_position_weighted') AS position_weighted, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'search_console_impressions' AND positioned.item_id IS NOT NULL) AS positioned_impressions FROM analytics_content_items i LEFT JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND (s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) LEFT JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots positioned ON s.metric = 'search_console_impressions' AND positioned.item_id = s.item_id AND positioned.metric_date = s.metric_date AND positioned.metric = 'search_console_position_weighted' WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, i.author, i.published_at) SELECT title, href, author, substr(published_at, 1, 10) AS published, signups, agent_native_signups, pageviews, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analytics_content_collection_runs r WHERE r.step = 'daily_dev' AND r.status = 'succeeded') THEN COALESCE(daily_dev_visits, 0) END AS daily_dev_visits, clicks, impressions, ROUND((position_weighted / NULLIF(positioned_impressions, 0))::numeric, 1)::float8 AS position FROM per_article ORDER BY signups DESC NULLS LAST, published_at DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Builder signups per week by author
panels.sql: WITH top_authors AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author FROM analytics_content_items i JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' AND (s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') HAVING SUM(s.value) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(s.value) DESC LIMIT 5), weeks AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author, CURRENT_DATE - 1 - ((CURRENT_DATE - 1 - s.metric_date::date) / 7) * 7 AS week_end, SUM(s.value) AS signups FROM analytics_content_items i JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id JOIN top_authors t ON t.author = COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' AND (s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY COALESCE(i.author, 'No author'), CURRENT_DATE - 1 - ((CURRENT_DATE - 1 - s.metric_date::date) / 7) * 7) SELECT author, to_char(week_end - 6, 'Mon FMDD') || '–' || CASE WHEN to_char(week_end - 6, 'MM') = to_char(week_end, 'MM') THEN to_char(week_end, 'FMDD') ELSE to_char(week_end, 'Mon FMDD') END AS week, signups FROM weeks ORDER BY week_end, author

config.description: The five authors with the most Builder signups in the time range. Each week ends on yesterday's weekday, so the oldest one can be partial.

panels.title: Authors
panels.sql: WITH per_article AS (SELECT i.id, i.title, i.url AS href, COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author, i.published_at, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch') AS signups, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'agent_native_signups') AS agent_native_signups FROM analytics_content_items i LEFT JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND (s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, i.author, i.published_at) SELECT author{{?breakdown}}, {{breakdown}}{{/breakdown}}, COUNT(*) AS articles, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signups > 0) AS with_signups, SUM(signups) AS signups, SUM(agent_native_signups) AS agent_native_signups FROM per_article GROUP BY author{{?breakdown}}, {{breakdown}}{{/breakdown}} ORDER BY signups DESC NULLS LAST

config.description: Signups in the time range. Articles counts all of an author's articles, whatever the range; With signups counts those with a Builder signup in it. A co-written article counts under its joint byline.

panels.title: Articles
panels.sql: WITH per_article AS (SELECT i.id, i.title, i.url AS href, COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author, i.published_at, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch') AS signups, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'agent_native_signups') AS agent_native_signups FROM analytics_content_items i LEFT JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND (s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, i.author, i.published_at) SELECT title, href, author, signups, agent_native_signups FROM per_article ORDER BY signups DESC NULLS LAST, published_at DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Builder signups per day, new and older articles
panels.sql: WITH RECURSIVE dates AS (SELECT CASE '{{timeRange}}' WHEN '7d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 7 WHEN '28d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 28 WHEN '90d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 90 WHEN 'custom' THEN NULLIF('{{timeRangeStart}}', '')::date ELSE (SELECT MIN(metric_date)::date FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'signups_first_touch') END AS day UNION ALL SELECT day + 1 FROM dates WHERE day < CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - 1, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END), totals AS (SELECT s.metric_date AS date, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE i.published_at >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS new_articles, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE i.published_at IS NULL OR i.published_at < to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS older FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' AND (s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY s.metric_date) SELECT to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, totals.new_articles, totals.older FROM dates LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.date = to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE dates.day <= CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - 1, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END ORDER BY dates.day

panels.title: New articles
panels.sql: SELECT i.title, i.url AS href, substr(i.published_at, 1, 10) AS published, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric_date >= substr(i.published_at, 1, 10) AND s.metric_date < to_char(substr(i.published_at, 1, 10)::date + 7, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS first_week, SUM(s.value) AS signups FROM analytics_content_items i LEFT JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' AND s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND substr(i.published_at, 1, 10)::date >= CURRENT_DATE - 90 GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, i.published_at ORDER BY i.published_at DESC

config.description: Articles published in the last 90 days, whatever the time range. Week 1 is an article's Builder signups in its first 7 days; Total is every Builder signup credited to it.

panels.title: Last 28 days against the 28 before
panels.sql: WITH windows AS (SELECT i.id, i.title, i.url AS href, COALESCE(SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')), 0) AS recent, COALESCE(SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')), 0) AS previous FROM analytics_content_items i JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' AND s.metric_date::date >= CURRENT_DATE - 56 AND s.metric_date::date < CURRENT_DATE WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url) SELECT title, href, recent, previous, CASE WHEN previous > 0 THEN (recent - previous) * 100.0 / previous END AS change FROM windows WHERE recent + previous >= 10 ORDER BY GREATEST(recent - previous, previous - recent) DESC, recent DESC

config.description: Builder signups in the last 28 full days against the 28 before, whatever the time range, for articles with at least 10 across both. The largest changes, up or down, come first; ⚠ marks a change over 30%.

panels.title: Search clicks per month
panels.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', s.metric_date::date), 'Mon ''YY') AS month, SUM(s.value) AS clicks FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric = 'search_console_clicks' AND s.metric_date::date >= (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '24 months')::date AND s.metric_date::date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date AND s.metric_date::date >= (SELECT (date_trunc('month', MIN(earliest.metric_date)::date - 1) + INTERVAL '1 month')::date FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots earliest WHERE earliest.metric = 'search_console_clicks') GROUP BY date_trunc('month', s.metric_date::date) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', s.metric_date::date)

config.description: Google search clicks to blog articles in each full month, up to two years back, whatever the time range. The month collection began in is left out unless it began on the 1st. Search Console keeps 16 months; the collection keeps each month from then on, so a month can be set against the same month a year before.

panels.title: Search clicks against a year before
panels.sql: WITH newest AS (SELECT MAX(metric_date)::date AS day, MIN(metric_date)::date AS first_day FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'search_console_clicks'), windows AS (SELECT i.title, i.url AS href, i.published_at, COALESCE(SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric_date::date > newest.day - 28), 0) AS recent, CASE WHEN newest.first_day <= newest.day - 391 AND (i.published_at IS NULL OR substr(i.published_at, 1, 10)::date <= newest.day - 391) THEN COALESCE(SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric_date::date > newest.day - 392 AND s.metric_date::date <= newest.day - 364), 0) END AS year_before FROM analytics_content_items i JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND s.metric = 'search_console_clicks' CROSS JOIN newest WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric_date::date > newest.day - INTERVAL '392 days' GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, i.published_at, newest.day, newest.first_day) SELECT title, href, recent, year_before, CASE WHEN year_before > 0 THEN (recent - year_before) * 100.0 / year_before END AS change FROM windows WHERE recent + COALESCE(year_before, 0) >= 20 ORDER BY GREATEST(recent - year_before, year_before - recent) DESC NULLS LAST, recent DESC, title

config.description: Search clicks in the newest 28 days Search Console has reported against the same 28 days 52 weeks earlier, whatever the time range, for articles with at least 20 across both. The largest changes come first. A year before stays blank until the collection reaches back that far, and for articles published since.

panels.title: Search queries
panels.sql: WITH newest AS (SELECT MAX(week_start)::date + 6 AS week_end FROM analytics_content_search_queries), per_query AS (SELECT i.title, i.url AS href, q.query, SUM(q.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(q.impressions) AS impressions, SUM(q.position_weighted) AS position_weighted FROM analytics_content_search_queries q JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = q.item_id CROSS JOIN newest WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND q.week_start::date + 6 >= CASE '{{timeRange}}' WHEN '7d' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - 7, newest.week_end) WHEN '28d' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - 28, newest.week_end) WHEN '90d' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE - 90, newest.week_end) WHEN 'custom' THEN NULLIF('{{timeRangeStart}}', '')::date ELSE q.week_start::date END AND q.week_start::date <= CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, q.query) SELECT query, title, href, impressions, clicks, ROUND((clicks / NULLIF(impressions, 0))::numeric, 4)::float8 AS click_rate, ROUND((position_weighted / NULLIF(impressions, 0))::numeric, 1)::float8 AS position FROM per_query ORDER BY clicks DESC, impressions DESC, query, title LIMIT 200

config.description: Each article's top Google queries, most clicks first. Queries are collected per week, Monday to Sunday, so a time range takes every whole week it touches. Search Console reports days late, so a 7, 28 or 90-day range also reaches back to the newest week collected. Search Console leaves rare and private queries out, so an article's queries add up to less than its search clicks.

panels.title: Close to the top of search
panels.sql: WITH recent AS (SELECT i.title, i.url AS href, q.query, SUM(q.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(q.impressions) AS impressions, SUM(q.position_weighted) / NULLIF(SUM(q.impressions), 0) AS position FROM analytics_content_search_queries q JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = q.item_id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND q.week_start::date >= CURRENT_DATE - 120 AND q.week_start::date > (SELECT MAX(newest.week_start)::date FROM analytics_content_search_queries newest) - 28 GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, q.query) SELECT query, title, href, impressions, clicks, ROUND((clicks / NULLIF(impressions, 0))::numeric, 4)::float8 AS click_rate, ROUND(position::numeric, 1)::float8 AS position FROM recent WHERE position >= 8 AND position <= 20 AND impressions >= 50 ORDER BY impressions DESC, query, title LIMIT 100

config.description: Queries an article averages position 8 to 20 for, the bottom of page one or the top of page two, over the four newest collected weeks, whatever the time range, with at least 50 impressions. The most impressions first: those gain most from a climb.

panels.title: Seen near the top, rarely clicked
panels.sql: WITH recent AS (SELECT i.title, i.url AS href, q.query, SUM(q.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(q.impressions) AS impressions, SUM(q.position_weighted) / NULLIF(SUM(q.impressions), 0) AS position FROM analytics_content_search_queries q JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = q.item_id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND q.week_start::date >= CURRENT_DATE - 120 AND q.week_start::date > (SELECT MAX(newest.week_start)::date FROM analytics_content_search_queries newest) - 28 GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, q.query) SELECT query, title, href, impressions, clicks, ROUND((clicks / NULLIF(impressions, 0))::numeric, 4)::float8 AS click_rate, ROUND(position::numeric, 1)::float8 AS position FROM recent WHERE position <= 5 AND impressions >= 100 AND clicks < impressions * 0.02 ORDER BY impressions DESC, query, title LIMIT 100

config.description: Queries an article averages a top-5 position for over the four newest collected weeks, whatever the time range, with at least 100 impressions but under 2% clicked. The title or description may not match what searchers want, or Google may answer them on the results page.

panels.title: YouTube views gained per day
panels.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(started_at) AS read_at FROM analytics_content_collection_runs WHERE step = 'youtube' AND status = 'succeeded'), reads AS (SELECT s.item_id, s.metric, s.metric_date, s.value, MAX(s.value) OVER (PARTITION BY s.item_id, s.metric ORDER BY s.metric_date ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS previous, MIN(s.metric_date) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(i.metadata::jsonb ->> 'channelId', ''), s.metric) AS channel_first_read, substr(i.published_at, 1, 10) AS published, COALESCE(i.author, 'No channel') AS channel, COALESCE(i.metadata::jsonb ->> 'channelId', '') AS channel_id, i.updated_at FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'youtube' AND s.metric IN ('youtube_views')), gains AS (SELECT channel_id, to_char(metric_date::date - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, value - COALESCE(previous, CASE WHEN metric_date > channel_first_read AND published >= channel_first_read THEN 0 END) AS views FROM reads), channels AS (SELECT r.channel_id, MAX(r.channel) AS channel FROM reads r JOIN latest l ON r.updated_at >= l.read_at GROUP BY r.channel_id), named AS (SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS sharing FROM channels GROUP BY channel) SELECT g.date, CASE WHEN n.sharing > 1 THEN c.channel || ' (' || g.channel_id || ')' ELSE c.channel END AS channel, SUM(g.views) AS views FROM gains g JOIN channels c ON c.channel_id = g.channel_id JOIN named n ON n.channel = c.channel WHERE g.views IS NOT NULL AND (date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY g.date, c.channel, g.channel_id, n.sharing ORDER BY g.date, channel

config.description: YouTube reports each video's views to date, read once a day; a day's views are what that count gained by the next day's read, so a missed read leaves a day without a bar and folds its views into the next one. A video published after its channel's first read counts from 0. A channel that shares its name with another is labeled with its channel ID too. Bars end the day before the newest read. Only channels the newest read covered are drawn, so a channel taken off the list drops off.

panels.title: Videos
panels.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(started_at) AS read_at FROM analytics_content_collection_runs WHERE step = 'youtube' AND status = 'succeeded'), reads AS (SELECT s.item_id, s.metric, s.metric_date, s.value, MAX(s.value) OVER (PARTITION BY s.item_id, s.metric ORDER BY s.metric_date ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS previous, MIN(s.metric_date) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(i.metadata::jsonb ->> 'channelId', ''), s.metric) AS channel_first_read, substr(i.published_at, 1, 10) AS published, COALESCE(i.author, 'No channel') AS channel FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'youtube' AND s.metric IN ('youtube_views', 'youtube_likes', 'youtube_comments')), ranked AS (SELECT item_id, metric, value, value - COALESCE(previous, CASE WHEN metric_date > channel_first_read AND published >= channel_first_read THEN 0 END) AS gained, to_char(metric_date::date - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gain_date, metric_date, MAX(metric_date) OVER (PARTITION BY item_id) AS last_read FROM reads), per_video AS (SELECT item_id, SUM(gained) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'youtube_views' AND (gain_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND gain_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND gain_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND gain_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND gain_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND gain_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}')))) AS views_gained, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'youtube_views' AND metric_date = last_read) AS views, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'youtube_likes' AND metric_date = last_read) AS likes, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'youtube_comments' AND metric_date = last_read) AS comments FROM ranked GROUP BY item_id) SELECT i.title, i.url AS href, COALESCE(i.author, 'No channel') AS channel, substr(i.published_at, 1, 10) AS published, CASE WHEN (i.metadata::jsonb ->> 'durationSeconds')::int >= 3600 THEN ((i.metadata::jsonb ->> 'durationSeconds')::int / 3600) || ':' || to_char(((i.metadata::jsonb ->> 'durationSeconds')::int / 60) % 60, 'FM00') || ':' || to_char((i.metadata::jsonb ->> 'durationSeconds')::int % 60, 'FM00') ELSE ((i.metadata::jsonb ->> 'durationSeconds')::int / 60) || ':' || to_char((i.metadata::jsonb ->> 'durationSeconds')::int % 60, 'FM00') END AS length, p.views_gained, p.views, p.likes, p.comments FROM analytics_content_items i JOIN per_video p ON p.item_id = i.id JOIN latest l ON i.updated_at >= l.read_at WHERE i.source = 'youtube' ORDER BY p.views_gained DESC NULLS LAST, p.views DESC NULLS LAST, i.published_at DESC NULLS LAST

config.description: Views gained in the time range, then each video's views, likes and comments as of the latest read. A blank count is one the channel hides. Only videos the newest read covered are listed.

panels.title: Views by day posted

config.description: Views of the posts that count, as of each post's latest read, stacked by account on the day it was posted (UTC). Recent days keep growing as their posts are read again at 1, 3, 7 and 30 days old. Reposts and replies are never read.

panels.sql: WITH reads AS (SELECT substr(i.published_at, 1, 10) AS date, COALESCE(i.author, 'No account') AS account, s.value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.item_id ORDER BY s.metric_date DESC) AS rn FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'x' AND i.relevance = 'counted' AND s.metric = 'x_views') SELECT date, account, SUM(value) AS views FROM reads WHERE rn = 1 AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}')) GROUP BY date, account ORDER BY date, account

panels.title: Posts

config.description: Posts that count, posted in the time range: every post from an account set to count all its posts, and other accounts' posts that link to or name the tracked sites. Views, likes, reposts and replies are from the latest read; views at 1, 3, 7 and 30 days are from the read made in the 30 hours after the post turned that old. A blank age column means that read hasn't come up yet, the post was first seen older than that, or the read was skipped to stay under the cap.

panels.sql: WITH reads AS (SELECT s.item_id, s.metric_date, MAX(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'x_views') AS views, MAX(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'x_likes') AS likes, MAX(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'x_reposts') AS reposts, MAX(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'x_replies') AS replies, MAX(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'x_age_hours') AS age_hours FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'x' AND i.relevance = 'counted' AND s.metric IN ('x_views', 'x_likes', 'x_reposts', 'x_replies', 'x_age_hours') GROUP BY s.item_id, s.metric_date), ranked AS (SELECT item_id, views, likes, reposts, replies, age_hours, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_id ORDER BY metric_date DESC) AS rn FROM reads), per_post AS (SELECT item_id, MAX(views) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS views, MAX(likes) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS likes, MAX(reposts) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS reposts, MAX(replies) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS replies, MAX(views) FILTER (WHERE age_hours >= 24 AND age_hours < 54) AS views_1d, MAX(views) FILTER (WHERE age_hours >= 72 AND age_hours < 102) AS views_3d, MAX(views) FILTER (WHERE age_hours >= 168 AND age_hours < 198) AS views_7d, MAX(views) FILTER (WHERE age_hours >= 720 AND age_hours < 750) AS views_30d FROM ranked GROUP BY item_id), posts AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.title, 'Post with no text') AS post, i.url AS href, COALESCE(i.author, 'No account') AS account, substr(i.published_at, 1, 10) AS posted, i.published_at, p.views, p.likes, p.reposts, p.replies, p.views_1d, p.views_3d, p.views_7d, p.views_30d FROM analytics_content_items i JOIN per_post p ON p.item_id = i.id WHERE i.source = 'x' AND i.relevance = 'counted') SELECT post, href, account, posted, views, likes, reposts, replies, views_1d, views_3d, views_7d, views_30d FROM posts WHERE ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND posted >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND posted >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND posted >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND posted >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND posted <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}')) ORDER BY views DESC NULLS LAST, published_at DESC

panels.title: Sources
panels.sql: WITH sources AS (SELECT 'builder_blog' AS step, 'Blog articles' AS label, 1 AS position, 'Titles, authors and publish dates.' AS about UNION ALL SELECT 'ga4', 'GA4 pageviews', 2, 'Daily pageviews per article, as GA4 counts them.' UNION ALL SELECT 'daily_dev', 'daily.dev visits', 3, 'Daily visits daily.dev sent each article, counted in the same GA4 property: sessions that landed with daily.dev''s via=dailydev tag or whose source was daily.dev.' UNION ALL SELECT 'search_console', 'Search Console', 4, 'Daily clicks, impressions and average position, 2 days behind. History fills back up to 16 months, about 90 days a run.' UNION ALL SELECT 'search_console_queries', 'Search queries', 5, 'Each article''s top queries per week, Monday to Sunday, once Search Console has the whole week. History fills back a few weeks a run.' UNION ALL SELECT 'signups', 'Builder signups', 6, 'Credited to the first article each person read.' UNION ALL SELECT 'agent_native_signups', 'Agent-Native signups', 7, 'Credited to the article tagged on their link.' UNION ALL SELECT 'youtube', 'YouTube videos', 8, 'Every video on the collection''s channels, with its views, likes and comments to date, read once a day.' UNION ALL SELECT 'x', 'X posts', 9, 'Posts by the collection''s X accounts that count, with views, likes, reposts and replies when first seen and again at 1, 3, 7 and 30 days old. X bills each read; collection stops before $25 a calendar month.'), latest AS (SELECT step, status, started_at, error_message, detail FROM (SELECT step, status, started_at, error_message, detail, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY step ORDER BY started_at DESC) AS rn FROM analytics_content_collection_runs WHERE started_at >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ranked WHERE rn = 1) SELECT COALESCE(sources.label, latest.step) AS source, CASE WHEN latest.status IS NULL THEN 'No run in 30 days' WHEN latest.status = 'succeeded' THEN 'Collected' WHEN latest.status = 'failed' THEN 'Failed' WHEN latest.status = 'cost_limited' THEN 'Cost-limited' WHEN latest.status = 'not_configured' THEN 'Not set up' WHEN latest.status = 'running' THEN 'Running' ELSE latest.status END AS status, COALESCE(latest.started_at, (SELECT MAX(any_run.started_at) FROM analytics_content_collection_runs any_run WHERE any_run.step = sources.step)) AS last_run, (SELECT successful.window_end FROM analytics_content_collection_runs successful WHERE successful.step = COALESCE(sources.step, latest.step) AND successful.status = 'succeeded' ORDER BY successful.started_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS data_through, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(earliest.metric_date) FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots earliest WHERE earliest.source = COALESCE(sources.step, latest.step)), (SELECT MIN(week.week_start) FROM analytics_content_search_queries week WHERE COALESCE(sources.step, latest.step) = 'search_console_queries'), (SELECT substr(MIN(item.first_seen_at), 1, 10) FROM analytics_content_items item WHERE item.source = 'builder_blog' AND COALESCE(sources.step, latest.step) = 'builder_blog')) AS first_data, COALESCE(latest.error_message, latest.detail, sources.about) AS detail FROM sources FULL JOIN latest ON latest.step = sources.step ORDER BY COALESCE(sources.position, 10), source

config.description: Each source's latest run in the last 30 days. First data is the earliest day it collected; Since collection began starts each chart at the first day of what it shows.
